thread:
maria: Quick sync — legal asked us to confirm the marketplace listing model rights before we open the partner portal. We have a partner that wants hosted + download SKU. Do we have a clean redwood-compatible license to present?

sam: @maria short answer: yes, but we need explicit redistribution + SI-embed clauses for download SKUs. I flagged two optional addenda: (1) geo-restrictions, (2) commercial use cap.

maria: Got it. Can you paste the minimal clause we should include in the marketplace terms? We want to keep public listing copy simple.

sam: Paste below — use as a one-liner in the listing and add link to full T&Cs: 
```
Redistribution: Partner may redistribute compiled weights under Partner License v1.0; commercial reselling requires separate agreement. Geo-restrictions apply as specified in Addendum A.
```
Use that + link to full addendum in partner portal.

dmitri: For the hosted endpoint we also need to confirm SDK/integration constraints — quantization/derivative weights allowed? Does the license let SI ship quantized variants as part of an on-prem SI bundle?

sam: Quantized variants = derivative. Allowed only if partner checks the derivative box and we add a provenance clause. We should require a checksum + provenance metadata in marketplace manifest.

kyle: Tagging @ella — announcement coordination: partner wants joint blog + marketplace feature the same week. We need embargo window + SKU readiness. Proposed dates: announcement 2026-10-13, marketplace listing 2026-10-15. Thoughts? :calendar:

ella: Dates look OK but we need 72h legal review + 48h ops readiness. That pushes listing to 2026-10-17 unless legal triages faster. Can we aim for soft-launch to partners on 2026-10-15?

maria: Soft-launch is fine. For public listing we'll mark "Coming soon" and enable download for verified partners only. Also planning a joint webinar 10/20.

kyle: For the marketplace SKU: should we expose two SKUs (hosted API / on-prem download) or a single SKU with fulfillment options? Ops prefers separate SKUs for metering/entitlement clarity.

dmitri: Separate SKUs also help the Optimize team recommend quantization profiles per SKU. I'm +1 for separate.

sam: Legal +1 for separate SKUs. Make sure you include clear entitlements in the license text and a checkbox for derivative rights during onboarding.

maria: Action items: 1) @sam to upload clause + Addendum A link to partner repo (due EOD). 2) @dmitri to confirm SDK gating for quantized artifacts (due +2 days). 3) @kyle/@ella to coordinate soft-launch cadence + partner comms (due +3 days). 4) @ops to prepare SKU mapping and entitlements (tagging integrations-bot).

integrations-bot: ops-ticket #ISS-4921 created: marketplace-sku-mapping + entitlement fields (assignee: ops-onboarding). ETA 2026-09-30.

maria: Thanks all — looping legal and ops in the partner onboarding doc: https://redwood.internal/partners/consignments/314159 (private). Will update once clauses live. :thumbsup:
